result.brief: 该研究对比自回归视频扩散模型与非自回归基线在生成未来帧时的内部表征与人脑视觉皮层fMRI响应的对齐程度，发现未来生成表征更契合高阶视觉皮层的预测性处理，并通过放大对齐层贡献提升人类偏好。
result.reason: Compares autoregressive video diffusion future-frame generation representations with visual cortex fMRI, showing predictive representations align better; directly informs video world models and video generation.
